default.label: Book a service slot by email or phone

default.content: Simple: message or call, and we arrange everything.
Email or call 070 815 379. Describe what is wrong with the bike and we arrange drop-off.
Bring the bike to the workshop. We give it a quick look and tell you what is needed and at what cost.
A mechanic does the work. When the bike is ready, we let you know.
Collect the bike and check that everything feels right. Payment on pickup.
Payment on pickup · Short test ride if you like

default.title: How do I book a service?
default.content: Call 070 815 379 or send an email. Describe the issue or the service you want, and we arrange bike drop-off. There are no fixed opening hours — appointments are always by agreement.

default.title: Which bikes do you service?
default.content: All of them: urban, road, gravel, mountain, and e-bikes (mechanical side). We have the most experience with MTB and trail, but we treat every type with the same care.

default.title: How soon will the bike be ready?
default.content: It depends on the scope and how busy we are. At drop-off we give an approximate date. Small urgent repairs are often quicker.

default.title: Do I need a deposit?
default.content: No. Payment on pickup. For more expensive parts we confirm with you first.

default.title: Do you service e-bikes?
default.content: Yes for the mechanical side. For batteries and motors we usually recommend the manufacturer service, except for straightforward jobs.
For a service booking or questions, reach us by email or phone. We work by appointment, without fixed opening hours.
